before: if (~g_en | OTP | latch_state | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
after: if (~en_SW | OTP | latch_state | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
proposal.description: In S_SS only the physical switch is checked for disable, so a host disable over SPI during soft start gates en but leaves the FSM ramping in S_SS
proposal.reason: If spi_enable falls while the FSM is in S_SS (with en_SW still high), en drops through the combinational gating, but the FSM stays in S_SS. ss_active stays high and state_out reads S_SS, and on SS_done the FSM moves to S_RUN instead of S_OFF.

before: if (~g_en | latch_state | OTP | latch_assert | UVLO) begin
after: if (~en_SW | latch_state | OTP | latch_assert | UVLO) begin
proposal.description: In S_HICCUP only the physical switch is checked for disable, so a host disable over SPI during the cool-down does not send the FSM to S_OFF and it still retries into S_SS
proposal.reason: If spi_enable falls during S_HICCUP (with en_SW high), hiccup_active stays high instead of dropping. When hiccup_done arrives, the FSM retries into S_SS, so ss_active and state_out show soft start on a converter the host has disabled.

before: if (~g_en | latch_state | OTP | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
proposal.description: Input undervoltage in S_RUN is treated as a recoverable brown-out under load and sent through the S_HICCUP cool-down instead of straight to S_OFF
proposal.reason: If UVLO asserts while regulating in S_RUN, the FSM goes to S_HICCUP instead of S_OFF: hiccup_active rises and state_out reads S_HICCUP. If UVLO has cleared by hiccup_done, the converter retries into S_SS on its own rather than restarting from S_OFF.
